title: Petrus Resources Declares Monthly Dividend for July 2026
body: CALGARY, Alberta, July 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Petrus Resources Ltd. (“Petrus” or the “Company”) (TSX: PRQ) is pleased to confirm that its Board of Directors has declared a monthly dividend in the amount of $0.01 per share payable July 31, 2026, to shareholders of record on July 15, 2026.
